name: delay-execute
description: Schedule a confirmed prompt to resume the current Codex CLI session on Linux.

interface.shortDescription: Resume this Codex chat at a confirmed future time.
interface.longDescription: Schedules confirmed prompts for an existing Codex CLI conversation, preferring safe delivery through the original tmux pane and supporting Git and non-Git directories.
defaultPrompt: $delay-execute 在凌晨 02:15 继续第五阶段的设计、开发和测试验证。
